But I will restore your health and heal your wounds, declares the LORD, because they call you an outcast, Zion, for whom no one cares.”

verses.text: So I will shatter Elam before their foes, before those who seek their lives. I will bring disaster upon them, even My fierce anger,” declares the LORD. “I will send out the sword after them until I finish them off.

xrefs.text: I will scatter them among the nations that neither they nor their fathers have known, and I will send a sword after them until I have finished them off.”
There is no longer praise for Moab; in Heshbon they devise evil against her: ‘Come, let us cut her off from nationhood.’ You too, O people of Madmen, will be silenced; the sword will pursue you.
A sword is against her false prophets, and they will become fools. A sword is against her warriors, and they will be filled with terror.
And I will scatter to every wind all the attendants around him and all his troops, and I will draw a sword to chase after them.
Damascus has become feeble; she has turned to flee. Panic has gripped her; anguish and pain have seized her like a woman in labor.

verses.text: I will set My throne in Elam, and destroy its king and officials,” declares the LORD.

xrefs.text: As I continued to watch, thrones were set in place, and the Ancient of Days took His seat. His clothing was white as snow, and the hair of His head was like pure wool. His throne was flaming with fire, and its wheels were all ablaze.

Then tell them that this is what the LORD of Hosts, the God of Israel, says: ‘I will send for My servant Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and I will set his throne over these stones that I have embedded, and he will spread his royal pavilion over them.

verses.text: “Yet in the last days, I will restore Elam from captivity, declares the LORD.

xrefs.text: Yet in the latter days I will restore Moab from captivity, declares the LORD. Here ends the judgment on Moab.
After Job had prayed for his friends, the LORD restored his prosperity and doubled his former possessions.
Therefore this is what the Lord GOD says: Now I will restore Jacob from captivity and will have compassion on the whole house of Israel, and I will be jealous for My holy name.
Yet afterward I will restore the Ammonites from captivity, declares the LORD.
In the last days the mountain of the house of the LORD will be established as the chief of the mountains; it will be raised above the hills, and the peoples will stream to it.
